topology_reasoning.evidence: The binary target has three disconnected material regions: a central left input that inverse-tapers to a tip near 25 um, plus two outer rails that begin near 3 um, widen while co-propagating beside the central guide, then S-bend symmetrically outward into two outputs.
topology_reasoning.operation: Light launched in the broad central input is transferred adiabatically into the paired outer rails as the central guide narrows; the outer rails then separate to form the two output branches.
topology_reasoning.construction: Use only gf.Path plus extrude and @gf.cell assembly: a straight central lead followed by a linear inverse taper, and a mirrored pair of linear outer tapers followed by raised-cosine S-bends and straight output sections. Material is layer (1, 0).
